14 一个人过年多没意思啊

sents.zh: 请问，您是王一飞老师的姐姐吗？
sents.en: May I ask, are you Teacher Wang Yifei's older sister?
sents.spokenZh: 请问，您是王一飞老师的姐姐吗？

sents.zh: 是的，你们就是她的学生吧？
sents.en: Yes, and you two must be her students, right?
sents.spokenZh: 是的，你们就是她的学生吧？

sents.zh: 对。我是白家月，她是安妮。
sents.en: Exactly. I'm Bai Jiayue, and this is Annie.
sents.spokenZh: 对。我是白家月，她是安妮。

sents.zh: 你们好，我叫王一雪。一飞给我打电话了，让我来接你们。
sents.en: Hello, I'm Wang Yixue. Yifei called me and asked me to pick you up.
sents.spokenZh: 你们好，我叫王一雪。一飞给我打电话了，让我来接你们。

sents.zh: 谢谢您。
sents.en: Thank you very much.
sents.spokenZh: 谢谢您。

sents.zh: 不客气。
sents.en: You're welcome.
sents.spokenZh: 不客气。

sents.zh: 你们是第一次来北京吗？
sents.en: Is this your first time in Beijing?
sents.spokenZh: 你们是第一次来北京吗？

sents.zh: 是的，我们都是第一次来。
sents.en: Yes, it's the first time for both of us.
sents.spokenZh: 是的，我们都是第一次来。

sents.zh: 你们是来学中文的吗？
sents.en: Are you here to learn Chinese?
sents.spokenZh: 你们是来学中文的吗？

sents.zh: 不是，我们是来旅游的。
sents.en: No, we're here for sightseeing.
sents.spokenZh: 不是，我们是来旅游的。

sents.zh: 我这几天都不忙，你们有事就找我。
sents.en: I'm not busy these days—if you need anything, just come to me.
sents.spokenZh: 我这几天都不忙，你们有事就找我。

sents.zh: 好的，谢谢您。
sents.en: Okay, thank you.
sents.spokenZh: 好的，谢谢您。

sents.zh: 喂，家月，你明天有时间吗？我想请你帮个忙。
sents.en: Hello, Jiayue, do you have time tomorrow? I'd like to ask you for a favor.
sents.spokenZh: 喂，家月，你明天有时间吗？我想请你帮个忙。

sents.zh: 不好意思，天中，我已经到北京了。
sents.en: Sorry, Tianzhong, I'm already in Beijing.
sents.spokenZh: 不好意思，天中，我已经到北京了。

sents.zh: 你是什么时候到的？
sents.en: When did you get there?
sents.spokenZh: 你是什么时候到的？

sents.zh: 我是今天早上到的。你有事可以叫李文帮忙，他还在学校呢。
sents.en: I arrived this morning. If you need anything, you can ask Li Wen for help—he's still at school.
sents.spokenZh: 我是今天早上到的。你有事可以叫李文帮忙，他还在学校呢。

sents.zh: 好的，那我给他打个电话。
sents.en: Okay, then I'll give him a call.
sents.spokenZh: 好的，那我给他打个电话。

sents.zh: 好，再见！
sents.en: All right, goodbye!
sents.spokenZh: 好，再见！

sents.zh: 王老师，我们已经到北京了，是您姐姐来接的我们。
sents.en: Ms. Wang, we've already arrived in Beijing—it was your sister who picked us up.
sents.spokenZh: 王老师，我们已经到北京了，是您姐姐来接的我们。

sents.zh: 她请我们吃了北京烤鸭，还给我们介绍了很多东西。
sents.en: She treated us to Peking Duck and told us about many things.
sents.spokenZh: 她请我们吃了北京烤鸭，还给我们介绍了很多东西。

sents.zh: 我们的中文不太好，有时不太懂她的意思。
sents.en: Our Chinese isn't very good, so sometimes we don't quite understand what she means.
sents.spokenZh: 我们的中文不太好，有时不太懂她的意思。

sents.zh: 请问，这儿有到北京大学的公交车吗？
sents.en: Excuse me, is there a bus from here to Peking University?
sents.spokenZh: 请问，这儿有到北京大学的公交车吗？

sents.zh: 有，但车站有点儿远。
sents.en: Yes, but the bus stop is a bit far.
sents.spokenZh: 有，但车站有点儿远。

sents.zh: 这儿好打车吗？
sents.en: Is it easy to get a taxi around here?
sents.spokenZh: 这儿好打车吗？

sents.zh: 好打车。
sents.en: Yes, it's easy.
sents.spokenZh: 好打车。

sents.zh: 谢谢。安妮，我们还是打车去吧。
sents.en: Thank you. Annie, let's take a taxi instead.
sents.spokenZh: 谢谢。安妮，我们还是打车去吧。

sents.zh: 好，没问题。
sents.en: Okay, no problem.
sents.spokenZh: 好，没问题。

sents.zh: 学校里人真多啊！
sents.en: There are so many people on campus!
sents.spokenZh: 学校里人真多啊！

sents.zh: 是啊，北京大学有四万多名学生呢！
sents.en: Yeah! Peking University has over forty thousand students!
sents.spokenZh: 是啊，北京大学有四万多名学生呢！

sents.zh: 你是怎么知道的？
sents.en: How do you know?
sents.spokenZh: 你是怎么知道的？

sents.zh: 是网上说的，网上还说北京大学有三千多名外国学生。
sents.en: I read it online—it also says Peking University has more than three thousand international students.
sents.spokenZh: 是网上说的，网上还说北京大学有三千多名外国学生。

sents.zh: 我也想来这儿学习。
sents.en: I'd love to study here too.
sents.spokenZh: 我也想来这儿学习。

sents.zh: 那边就有一间教室，我们去看一下吧。
sents.en: There's a classroom right over there—let's go take a look.
sents.spokenZh: 那边就有一间教室，我们去看一下吧。

sents.zh: 家月，你看，学校里有家电影院！
sents.en: Jiayue, look, there's a cinema on campus!
sents.spokenZh: 家月，你看，学校里有家电影院！

sents.zh: 是啊，电影院还不小。
sents.en: Yeah, and it's not small either.
sents.spokenZh: 是啊，电影院还不小。

sents.zh: 他们卖的电影票也很便宜。
sents.en: The movie tickets they sell are really cheap too.
sents.spokenZh: 他们卖的电影票也很便宜。

sents.zh: 天啊！有的还不到二十块钱。
sents.en: Goodness! Some are less than twenty yuan.
sents.spokenZh: 天啊！有的还不到二十块钱。

sents.zh: 那你想不想去看个电影？
sents.en: So, do you want to go watch a movie?
sents.spokenZh: 那你想不想去看个电影？

sents.zh: 还是别看电影了，北京大学就很好看！
sents.en: Let's skip the movie—Peking University itself is well worth seeing!
sents.spokenZh: 还是别看电影了，北京大学就很好看！

sents.zh: 北京大学很大，有四万多名学生。
sents.en: Peking University is huge, with over forty thousand students.
sents.spokenZh: 北京大学很大，有四万多名学生。

sents.zh: 学校很漂亮，里边还有家电影院，电影票也不贵，我们有时间还想再过来看个电影。
sents.en: The campus is beautiful, and there's even a cinema inside; the tickets aren't expensive, so when we have time we'd like to come back and watch a movie.
sents.spokenZh: 学校很漂亮，里边还有家电影院，电影票也不贵，我们有时间还想再过来看个电影。

sents.zh: 今天回来这么晚啊！
sents.en: You're back so late today!
sents.spokenZh: 今天回来这么晚啊！

sents.zh: 工作太多了，下班的时候没做完。
sents.en: I had too much work and hadn't finished it by the time work ended.
sents.spokenZh: 工作太多了，下班的时候没做完。

sents.zh: 菜都做好了，过来吃饭吧。
sents.en: Dinner's all ready—come and eat.
sents.spokenZh: 菜都做好了，过来吃饭吧。

sents.zh: 我想休息一下，喝杯水。
sents.en: I'd like to rest a bit and have a glass of water.
sents.spokenZh: 我想休息一下，喝杯水。

sents.zh: 好的。
sents.en: Okay.
sents.spokenZh: 好的。

sents.zh: 我们找个时间去旅游，怎么样？
sents.en: How about we find some time to go on a trip?
sents.spokenZh: 我们找个时间去旅游，怎么样？

sents.zh: 好啊，我也很想一起出去玩。
sents.en: Great! I've also been wanting to go out and have fun together.
sents.spokenZh: 好啊，我也很想一起出去玩。

sents.zh: 你想去哪儿？
sents.en: Where do you want to go?
sents.spokenZh: 你想去哪儿？

sents.zh: 我还没想好呢。
sents.en: I haven't decided yet.
sents.spokenZh: 我还没想好呢。

sents.zh: 那你再想一想，你想好了，我来买票。
sents.en: Then think it over some more—once you've decided, I'll buy the tickets.
sents.spokenZh: 那你再想一想，你想好了，我来买票。

sents.zh: 吃个苹果吧，我都洗好了。
sents.en: Have an apple—I've washed them all.
sents.spokenZh: 吃个苹果吧，我都洗好了。

sents.zh: 就在桌子上，你自己拿。
sents.en: They're right on the table—help yourself.
sents.spokenZh: 就在桌子上，你自己拿。

sents.zh: 我去洗洗手。对了，我们去西安旅游，怎么样？
sents.en: I'll go wash my hands. By the way, how about taking a trip to Xi'an?
sents.spokenZh: 我去洗洗手。对了，我们去西安旅游，怎么样？

sents.zh: 为什么想去西安？
sents.en: Why do you want to go to Xi'an?
sents.spokenZh: 为什么想去西安？

sents.zh: 我看了看网上的介绍，这个时候去西安很不错！
sents.en: I read some introductions online—this is a great time to visit Xi'an!
sents.spokenZh: 我看了看网上的介绍，这个时候去西安很不错！

sents.zh: 早上，刘明开车送孩子去学校，送完孩子回家后，医院就来电话了，让他回去上班。
sents.en: In the morning, Liu Ming drove the child to school, and just after he got home, the hospital called and asked him to go back to work.
sents.spokenZh: 早上，刘明开车送孩子去学校，送完孩子回家后，医院就来电话了，让他回去上班。

sents.zh: 我觉得他这个月每天都很累，真想让他休息休息。
sents.en: I feel he's been exhausted every day this month—I really wish he could get some rest.
sents.spokenZh: 我觉得他这个月每天都很累，真想让他休息休息。

sents.zh: 妈妈，我们来过这家商场吗？
sents.en: Mom, have we been to this shopping mall before?
sents.spokenZh: 妈妈，我们来过这家商场吗？

sents.zh: 没来过，这是新开的。
sents.en: No, we haven't. It just opened recently.
sents.spokenZh: 没来过，这是新开的。

sents.zh: 我们进去看看吧。
sents.en: Let's go in and have a look.
sents.spokenZh: 我们进去看看吧。

sents.zh: 好啊！你想买点儿什么？
sents.en: Sure! What do you want to buy?
sents.spokenZh: 好啊！你想买点儿什么？

sents.zh: 我想买条裤子。
sents.en: I want to buy a pair of pants.
sents.spokenZh: 我想买条裤子。

sents.zh: 没问题。
sents.en: No problem.
sents.spokenZh: 没问题。

sents.zh: 妈妈，我想买这条白色的裤子。
sents.en: Mom, I want to buy this pair of white pants.
sents.spokenZh: 妈妈，我想买这条白色的裤子。

sents.zh: 你有很多白色的衣服，为什么还买白色的？
sents.en: You already have lots of white clothes. Why buy white again?
sents.spokenZh: 你有很多白色的衣服，为什么还买白色的？

sents.zh: 因为我喜欢白色啊！
sents.en: Because I like white!
sents.spokenZh: 因为我喜欢白色啊！

sents.zh: 我觉得这条白色的不太好看，你试试那条红色的吧。
sents.en: I don't think this white one looks very good. Why don't you try that red one?
sents.spokenZh: 我觉得这条白色的不太好看，你试试那条红色的吧。

sents.zh: 我没穿过红色的，红色的好看吗？
sents.en: I've never worn red before. Does red look good?
sents.spokenZh: 我没穿过红色的，红色的好看吗？

sents.zh: 就是因为没穿过，所以要试试啊！
sents.en: That's exactly why you should give it a try!
sents.spokenZh: 就是因为没穿过，所以要试试啊！

sents.zh: 妈妈，我想买个新书包。
sents.en: Mom, I want to buy a new schoolbag.
sents.spokenZh: 妈妈，我想买个新书包。

sents.zh: 好，那边卖书包，我们过去看看吧。
sents.en: Okay. They sell schoolbags over there. Let's go take a look.
sents.spokenZh: 好，那边卖书包，我们过去看看吧。

sents.zh: 这么多漂亮的书包！
sents.en: So many beautiful schoolbags!
sents.spokenZh: 这么多漂亮的书包！

sents.zh: 红色的、绿色的、黑色的，你想买哪个？
sents.en: Red ones, green ones, black ones—which one do you want?
sents.spokenZh: 红色的、绿色的、黑色的，你想买哪个？

sents.zh: 绿色的吧。
sents.en: The green one.
sents.spokenZh: 绿色的吧。

sents.zh: 不错，我也觉得绿色的更好看。
sents.en: Not bad. I think the green one looks better too.
sents.spokenZh: 不错，我也觉得绿色的更好看。

sents.zh: 我和妈妈去了一家商场。
sents.en: I went to a shopping mall with my mom.
sents.spokenZh: 我和妈妈去了一家商场。

sents.zh: 因为是新开的，所以这几天东西很便宜。
sents.en: Since it just opened, things have been really cheap these days.
sents.spokenZh: 因为是新开的，所以这几天东西很便宜。

sents.zh: 商场里的衣服颜色很多。
sents.en: The clothes in the mall come in many colors.
sents.spokenZh: 商场里的衣服颜色很多。

sents.zh: 我没穿过红色的裤子，妈妈让我试了试，我觉得我穿红色的也很好看。
sents.en: I had never worn red pants before, but my mom had me try them on, and I thought I looked pretty good in red too.
sents.spokenZh: 我没穿过红色的裤子，妈妈让我试了试，我觉得我穿红色的也很好看。

sents.zh: 家月，快下来吧，第一次去中国朋友家，别晚了。
sents.en: Jiayue, come down quickly. It's our first time visiting a Chinese friend's home—don't be late.
sents.spokenZh: 家月，快下来吧，第一次去中国朋友家，别晚了。

sents.zh: 还有时间，你上来吧。
sents.en: We still have time. Why don't you come up?
sents.spokenZh: 还有时间，你上来吧。

sents.zh: 我不上去了，就在下面等你。
sents.en: I'm not going up. I'll just wait for you downstairs.
sents.spokenZh: 我不上去了，就在下面等你。

sents.zh: 那我一会儿就下去。
sents.en: Then I'll come down in a bit.
sents.spokenZh: 那我一会儿就下去。

sents.zh: 你快点儿吧。
sents.en: Hurry up.
sents.spokenZh: 你快点儿吧。

sents.zh: 没事，一雪姐说十一点前到就可以。
sents.en: It's fine. Sister Yixue said we just need to arrive before eleven.
sents.spokenZh: 没事，一雪姐说十一点前到就可以。

sents.zh: 家月、安妮，快进来！我给你们介绍一下，这是孩子们的爷爷、奶奶。
sents.en: Jiayue, Annie, come on in! Let me introduce you—these are the children's grandfather and grandmother.
sents.spokenZh: 家月、安妮，快进来！我给你们介绍一下，这是孩子们的爷爷、奶奶。

sents.zh: 你们好！
sents.en: Hello!
sents.spokenZh: 你们好！

sents.zh: 爸，妈，这是白家月，这是安妮。她们都是一飞的学生。
sents.en: Dad, Mom, this is Bai Jiayue, and this is Annie. They're both Yifei's students.
sents.spokenZh: 爸，妈，这是白家月，这是安妮。她们都是一飞的学生。

sents.zh: 家月、安妮，你们好！
sents.en: Hello, Jiayue and Annie!
sents.spokenZh: 家月、安妮，你们好！

sents.zh: 这是送你们的礼物。
sents.en: These are gifts for you.
sents.spokenZh: 这是送你们的礼物。

sents.zh: 你们太客气了，还拿这么多礼物来！
sents.en: You're too kind—bringing so many gifts!
sents.spokenZh: 你们太客气了，还拿这么多礼物来！

sents.zh: 一雪姐，这是给孩子们准备的礼物。
sents.en: Sister Yixue, this is the gift we prepared for the children.
sents.spokenZh: 一雪姐，这是给孩子们准备的礼物。

sents.zh: 谢谢！你们别客气，快坐吧！
sents.en: Thank you! Make yourselves at home—please, have a seat!
sents.spokenZh: 谢谢！你们别客气，快坐吧！

sents.zh: 都十二点了，我们吃饭吧。
sents.en: It's already twelve o'clock. Let's eat.
sents.spokenZh: 都十二点了，我们吃饭吧。

sents.zh: 这么多好吃的，您太客气了！
sents.en: So many delicious dishes—you're really too kind!
sents.spokenZh: 这么多好吃的，您太客气了！

sents.zh: 都是我自己做的，你们多吃点儿。
sents.en: I made all of these myself. Please eat as much as you like.
sents.spokenZh: 都是我自己做的，你们多吃点儿。

sents.zh: 奶茶也很好喝，是您自己做的吗？
sents.en: The bubble tea is delicious too. Did you make it yourself?
sents.spokenZh: 奶茶也很好喝，是您自己做的吗？

sents.zh: 不是，奶茶是爷爷买的。
sents.en: No, Grandpa bought the bubble tea.
sents.spokenZh: 不是，奶茶是爷爷买的。

sents.zh: 在哪儿买的？我还没喝过这么好喝的奶茶。
sents.en: Where did he buy it? I've never had bubble tea this good before.
sents.spokenZh: 在哪儿买的？我还没喝过这么好喝的奶茶。

sents.zh: 就在前边的商场，吃完饭你们可以跟我去看看。
sents.en: At the mall just up ahead. After we finish eating, you can come with me to check it out.
sents.spokenZh: 就在前边的商场，吃完饭你们可以跟我去看看。

sents.zh: 回国前一天，我们去一雪姐家了。
sents.en: The day before we returned to our countries, we visited Sister Yixue's home.
sents.spokenZh: 回国前一天，我们去一雪姐家了。

sents.zh: 到她家的时候，饭菜都做好了。
sents.en: When we arrived, the food was already prepared.
sents.spokenZh: 到她家的时候，饭菜都做好了。

sents.zh: 刘爷爷还准备了奶茶。
sents.en: Grandpa Liu had even prepared bubble tea.
sents.spokenZh: 刘爷爷还准备了奶茶。

sents.zh: 因为吃了太多东西，我们吃完饭是走回酒店的。
sents.en: Because we ate so much, we walked back to the hotel after the meal.
sents.spokenZh: 因为吃了太多东西，我们吃完饭是走回酒店的。

sents.zh: 明天就是女儿的生日了。
sents.en: Tomorrow is our daughter's birthday.
sents.spokenZh: 明天就是女儿的生日了。

sents.zh: 你不说，我还真忘了。我们给她准备个什么礼物呢？
sents.en: If you hadn't mentioned it, I would have completely forgotten. What gift should we prepare for her?
sents.spokenZh: 你不说，我还真忘了。我们给她准备个什么礼物呢？

sents.zh: 她喜欢画画，你觉得画笔怎么样？
sents.en: She likes drawing. How about some color pens?
sents.spokenZh: 她喜欢画画，你觉得画笔怎么样？

sents.zh: 就送画笔吧！
sents.en: Let's give her color pens then!
sents.spokenZh: 就送画笔吧！

sents.zh: 那我明天上午就去买。
sents.en: Then I'll go buy them tomorrow morning.
sents.spokenZh: 那我明天上午就去买。

sents.zh: 好的！我再给她买个大大的生日蛋糕。
sents.en: Great! And I'll also buy her a great big birthday cake.
sents.spokenZh: 好的！我再给她买个大大的生日蛋糕。

sents.zh: 小雪，生日快乐！
sents.en: Happy birthday, Xiaoxue!
sents.spokenZh: 小雪，生日快乐！

sents.zh: 姐姐，生日快乐！
sents.en: Happy birthday, sis!
sents.spokenZh: 姐姐，生日快乐！

sents.zh: 小雪，这是爸爸、妈妈送你的礼物。
sents.en: Xiaoxue, here's a gift from Dad and Mom.
sents.spokenZh: 小雪，这是爸爸、妈妈送你的礼物。

sents.zh: 你打开看看喜欢不喜欢。
sents.en: Open it and see if you like it.
sents.spokenZh: 你打开看看喜欢不喜欢。

sents.zh: 画笔！我很喜欢！
sents.en: Color pens! I love them!
sents.spokenZh: 画笔！我很喜欢！

sents.zh: 那你想画点儿什么？
sents.en: So what would you like to draw?
sents.spokenZh: 那你想画点儿什么？

sents.zh: 画我们的家！有爸爸、妈妈、弟弟，还有黑色的狗、白色的猫什么的。
sents.en: Our home! With Dad, Mom, my little brother, plus our black dog, white cat, and so on.
sents.spokenZh: 画我们的家！有爸爸、妈妈、弟弟，还有黑色的狗、白色的猫什么的。

sents.zh: 那我要画一个穿白色衣服的姐姐。
sents.en: Then I'll draw a big sister wearing white clothes.
sents.spokenZh: 那我要画一个穿白色衣服的姐姐。

sents.zh: 小雪，看看今天有什么好吃的。
sents.en: Xiaoxue, take a look at all the delicious food we have today.
sents.spokenZh: 小雪，看看今天有什么好吃的。

sents.zh: 长长的面条儿，大大的蛋糕。
sents.en: Long, long noodles and a great big cake.
sents.spokenZh: 长长的面条儿，大大的蛋糕。

sents.zh: 你看，还有鱼啊肉啊什么的，都是你喜欢吃的。
sents.en: Look, there's also fish, meat, and more—all your favorites.
sents.spokenZh: 你看，还有鱼啊肉啊什么的，都是你喜欢吃的。

sents.zh: 谢谢爸爸、妈妈！
sents.en: Thank you, Dad and Mom!
sents.spokenZh: 谢谢爸爸、妈妈！

sents.zh: 快去叫弟弟过来吃饭吧，吃完饭我们还要出去玩呢。
sents.en: Go call your little brother over to eat. After dinner we're going out to have some fun!
sents.spokenZh: 快去叫弟弟过来吃饭吧，吃完饭我们还要出去玩呢。

sents.zh: 过生日真好啊！
sents.en: Birthdays are so wonderful!
sents.spokenZh: 过生日真好啊！

sents.zh: 是的，过生日就要吃好吃的，还要高高兴兴地玩。
sents.en: That's right! On your birthday you should eat delicious food and play to your heart's content.
sents.spokenZh: 是的，过生日就要吃好吃的，还要高高兴兴地玩。

sents.zh: 今天是女儿的生日。
sents.en: Today was our daughter's birthday.
sents.spokenZh: 今天是女儿的生日。

sents.zh: 我们买了蛋糕，做了面条儿，还做了鱼啊肉啊什么的。
sents.en: We bought a cake, made noodles, and also cooked fish, meat, and other dishes.
sents.spokenZh: 我们买了蛋糕，做了面条儿，还做了鱼啊肉啊什么的。

sents.zh: 吃完晚饭，一家人去看了个电影。
sents.en: After dinner, the whole family went to watch a movie.
sents.spokenZh: 吃完晚饭，一家人去看了个电影。

sents.zh: 回家后，孩子们早早地就上床了。
sents.en: After we got home, the children went to bed early.
sents.spokenZh: 回家后，孩子们早早地就上床了。

sents.zh: 明天不上学，他们说要舒舒服服地睡一觉，让我们晚点儿叫他们起床。
sents.en: There's no school tomorrow, so they said they wanted to sleep soundly and comfortably, and asked us to wake them up a bit later.
sents.spokenZh: 明天不上学，他们说要舒舒服服地睡一觉，让我们晚点儿叫他们起床。

sents.zh: 这是很忙、很累，但很快乐的一天。
sents.en: It was a busy and tiring day, but a very happy one.
sents.spokenZh: 这是很忙、很累，但很快乐的一天。

sents.zh: 安妮，你是什么时候从北京回来的？
sents.en: Annie, when did you get back from Beijing?
sents.spokenZh: 安妮，你是什么时候从北京回来的？

sents.zh: 昨天下午。天中，你怎么一下课就往外跑？
sents.en: Yesterday afternoon. Tianzhong, why do you rush out as soon as class ends?
sents.spokenZh: 昨天下午。天中，你怎么一下课就往外跑？

sents.zh: 我跟同学说好了，一起去打篮球。
sents.en: I made plans with my classmates to play basketball together.
sents.spokenZh: 我跟同学说好了，一起去打篮球。

sents.zh: 我也想跟你们一起玩。
sents.en: I want to join you too.
sents.spokenZh: 我也想跟你们一起玩。

sents.zh: 没问题，走吧。
sents.en: No problem, let's go.
sents.spokenZh: 没问题，走吧。

sents.zh: 天中，你是不是很喜欢打篮球？
sents.en: Tianzhong, do you really like playing basketball?
sents.spokenZh: 天中，你是不是很喜欢打篮球？

sents.zh: 没错。
sents.en: That's right.
sents.spokenZh: 没错。

sents.zh: 你还喜欢什么运动？
sents.en: What other sports do you like?
sents.spokenZh: 你还喜欢什么运动？

sents.zh: 我还喜欢踢足球，一到星期天就跟朋友们去踢球。
sents.en: I also like playing soccer; every Sunday I go play with my friends.
sents.spokenZh: 我还喜欢踢足球，一到星期天就跟朋友们去踢球。

sents.zh: 你踢得怎么样？
sents.en: How well do you play?
sents.spokenZh: 你踢得怎么样？

sents.zh: 我踢得还可以。
sents.en: I play okay.
sents.spokenZh: 我踢得还可以。

sents.zh: 你篮球打得怎么样？
sents.en: How are your basketball skills?
sents.spokenZh: 你篮球打得怎么样？

sents.zh: 打得还可以。
sents.en: Not too bad.
sents.spokenZh: 打得还可以。

sents.zh: 跑步呢？你跑得快不快？
sents.en: What about running? Are you fast?
sents.spokenZh: 跑步呢？你跑得快不快？

sents.zh: 我跑得不快，也不太喜欢跑步。
sents.en: I'm not fast, and I don't really like running either.
sents.spokenZh: 我跑得不快，也不太喜欢跑步。

sents.zh: 那你喜欢游泳吗？
sents.en: Do you like swimming, then?
sents.spokenZh: 那你喜欢游泳吗？

sents.zh: 喜欢，但我游泳游得不快。
sents.en: I do, but I don't swim very fast.
sents.spokenZh: 喜欢，但我游泳游得不快。

sents.zh: 我的爱好是运动。
sents.en: My hobby is doing sports.
sents.spokenZh: 我的爱好是运动。

sents.zh: 从上小学开始，我每天都跟爸爸去运动。
sents.en: Since primary school, I've been exercising with my dad every day.
sents.spokenZh: 从上小学开始，我每天都跟爸爸去运动。

sents.zh: 现在我篮球打得很好，足球踢得不错，游泳游得也很快。
sents.en: Now I play basketball very well, play soccer quite well, and swim very fast too.
sents.spokenZh: 现在我篮球打得很好，足球踢得不错，游泳游得也很快。

sents.zh: 我一有时间就去运动。
sents.en: Whenever I have time, I go do sports.
sents.spokenZh: 我一有时间就去运动。

sents.zh: 你看，这两块手表怎么样？
sents.en: Look, what do you think of these two watches?
sents.spokenZh: 你看，这两块手表怎么样？

sents.zh: 都不错！
sents.en: They're both nice!
sents.spokenZh: 都不错！

sents.zh: 我喜欢左边这个。
sents.en: I like the one on the left.
sents.spokenZh: 我喜欢左边这个。

sents.zh: 我也觉得左边的比右边的好看。
sents.en: I also think the left one looks better than the right one.
sents.spokenZh: 我也觉得左边的比右边的好看。

sents.zh: 你看看要多少钱！
sents.en: Check how much it costs!
sents.spokenZh: 你看看要多少钱！

sents.zh: 真不便宜！八千八！
sents.en: It's really not cheap! 8,800!
sents.spokenZh: 真不便宜！八千八！

sents.zh: 今天有不少电影，我们看个电影吧。
sents.en: There are quite a few movies today. Let's watch one.
sents.spokenZh: 今天有不少电影，我们看个电影吧。

sents.zh: 好啊！我们看哪个？
sents.en: Great! Which one should we watch?
sents.spokenZh: 好啊！我们看哪个？

sents.zh: 我记得你喜欢看爱情片，我们看那个爱情片，怎么样？
sents.en: I remember you like romantic movies. How about that romantic one?
sents.spokenZh: 我记得你喜欢看爱情片，我们看那个爱情片，怎么样？

sents.zh: 还是看这个吧，我看网上说这个电影比那个爱情片更有意思。
sents.en: Let's watch this one instead — I read online that it's more interesting than that romantic one.
sents.spokenZh: 还是看这个吧，我看网上说这个电影比那个爱情片更有意思。

sents.zh: 好。我去买票。
sents.en: Okay. I'll go buy the tickets.
sents.spokenZh: 好。我去买票。

sents.zh: 到网上买吧，网上买比在这里买便宜。
sents.en: Buy them online — it's cheaper online than here.
sents.spokenZh: 到网上买吧，网上买比在这里买便宜。

sents.zh: 您好！就要这几个菜吧，谢谢！
sents.en: Hello! We'll have these dishes, thank you!
sents.spokenZh: 您好！就要这几个菜吧，谢谢！

sents.zh: 怎么点这么多菜？
sents.en: Why did you order so many dishes?
sents.spokenZh: 怎么点这么多菜？

sents.zh: 你想想，今天是几月几号？
sents.en: Think about it — what's the date today?
sents.spokenZh: 你想想，今天是几月几号？

sents.zh: 八月二十七号。啊！我的生日！
sents.en: August 27th. Ah! My birthday!
sents.spokenZh: 八月二十七号。啊！我的生日！

sents.zh: 生日快乐！虽然你忘了，但是我记得。看看这是什么？
sents.en: Happy birthday! Even though you forgot, I remembered. Look, what's this?
sents.spokenZh: 生日快乐！虽然你忘了，但是我记得。看看这是什么？

sents.zh: 手表！吃饭、看电影、买手表，今天花了不少钱吧？
sents.en: The watch! Dinner, a movie, and the watch — you must have spent a lot today, right?
sents.spokenZh: 手表！吃饭、看电影、买手表，今天花了不少钱吧？

sents.zh: 虽然花了一些钱，但是我们过了一个快乐的生日。
sents.en: Although we spent some money, we celebrated a happy birthday.
sents.spokenZh: 虽然花了一些钱，但是我们过了一个快乐的生日。

sents.zh: 虽然妻子忘了今天是自己的生日，但是丈夫记得。
sents.en: Although the wife forgot that today was her own birthday, the husband remembered.
sents.spokenZh: 虽然妻子忘了今天是自己的生日，但是丈夫记得。

sents.zh: 丈夫请妻子去饭馆吃饭、去电影院看电影，还给妻子买了一块非常漂亮的手表。
sents.en: The husband treated his wife to a meal at a restaurant and a movie at the cinema, and also bought her a very beautiful watch.
sents.spokenZh: 丈夫请妻子去饭馆吃饭、去电影院看电影，还给妻子买了一块非常漂亮的手表。

sents.zh: 妻子觉得今天很快乐。
sents.en: The wife felt very happy today.
sents.spokenZh: 妻子觉得今天很快乐。

sents.zh: 儿子的裤子坏了，我们给他买条新的吧。
sents.en: Our son's pants are ruined. Let's buy him a new pair.
sents.spokenZh: 儿子的裤子坏了，我们给他买条新的吧。

sents.zh: 好啊。
sents.en: Okay.
sents.spokenZh: 好啊。

sents.zh: 你看这条黑色的怎么样？
sents.en: What do you think of this black pair?
sents.spokenZh: 你看这条黑色的怎么样？

sents.zh: 没有你上次买的那条好看。
sents.en: They're not as nice as the pair you bought last time.
sents.spokenZh: 没有你上次买的那条好看。

sents.zh: 旁边那个男孩儿就穿了这样的裤子，我觉得很好看啊！
sents.en: The boy next to us is wearing pants just like these, and I think they look great!
sents.spokenZh: 旁边那个男孩儿就穿了这样的裤子，我觉得很好看啊！

sents.zh: 儿子的个子没有他那么高，穿上就不会太好看。
sents.en: Our son isn't as tall as him, so they wouldn't look so good on him.
sents.spokenZh: 儿子的个子没有他那么高，穿上就不会太好看。

sents.zh: 好吧，我们再去那边看看。
sents.en: Alright, let's go over there and take another look.
sents.spokenZh: 好吧，我们再去那边看看。

sents.zh: 门口有家奶茶店。你想喝杯奶茶吗？
sents.en: There's a bubble tea shop at the entrance. Do you want a cup of bubble tea?
sents.spokenZh: 门口有家奶茶店。你想喝杯奶茶吗？

sents.zh: 我想喝咖啡，还是去咖啡店吧。
sents.en: I'd rather have coffee — let's go to a coffee shop.
sents.spokenZh: 我想喝咖啡，还是去咖啡店吧。

sents.zh: 咖啡店离这儿有点儿远。
sents.en: The coffee shop is a bit far from here.
sents.spokenZh: 咖啡店离这儿有点儿远。

sents.zh: 没关系，那家店的咖啡很好喝。
sents.en: That's fine — that shop's coffee is really good.
sents.spokenZh: 没关系，那家店的咖啡很好喝。

sents.zh: 那你等一下，我去买杯奶茶。
sents.en: Then wait a moment — I'll go buy a cup of bubble tea.
sents.spokenZh: 那你等一下，我去买杯奶茶。

sents.zh: 你不想喝咖啡吗？
sents.en: Don't you want coffee?
sents.spokenZh: 你不想喝咖啡吗？

sents.zh: 喝了咖啡，晚上就别想睡觉了。
sents.en: If I drink coffee, I can forget about sleeping tonight.
sents.spokenZh: 喝了咖啡，晚上就别想睡觉了。

sents.zh: 我们打车回去吧。
sents.en: Let's take a taxi home.
sents.spokenZh: 我们打车回去吧。

sents.zh: 这里离家很近，还是走路吧。
sents.en: It's very close to home from here — let's walk instead.
sents.spokenZh: 这里离家很近，还是走路吧。

sents.zh: 要走多长时间？
sents.en: How long will the walk take?
sents.spokenZh: 要走多长时间？

sents.zh: 走半个多小时就到了。
sents.en: A little over half an hour and we'll be there.
sents.spokenZh: 走半个多小时就到了。

sents.zh: 好的。每天上下班都坐车，今天运动运动吧。
sents.en: Alright. I ride to and from work every day — let's get some exercise today.
sents.spokenZh: 好的。每天上下班都坐车，今天运动运动吧。

sents.zh: 这周刘明休息，我下班后跟他去了一家商店。
sents.en: Liu Ming is off this week, so I went to a store with him after work.
sents.spokenZh: 这周刘明休息，我下班后跟他去了一家商店。

sents.zh: 商店里边的衣服没有大商场里的好看。
sents.en: The clothes in the store weren't as nice as those in big shopping malls.
sents.spokenZh: 商店里边的衣服没有大商场里的好看。

sents.zh: 我们没有买到喜欢的衣服，从商店出来就到咖啡店坐了坐。
sents.en: We didn't find any clothes we liked, so after leaving the store we sat for a while at a coffee shop.
sents.spokenZh: 我们没有买到喜欢的衣服，从商店出来就到咖啡店坐了坐。

sents.zh: 因为想运动运动，所以喝完东西，我们就走回家了。
sents.en: Since we wanted to get some exercise, we walked home after finishing our drinks.
sents.spokenZh: 因为想运动运动，所以喝完东西，我们就走回家了。

sents.zh: 小明，你们明天开学，你准备好了吗？
sents.en: Xiaoming, school starts tomorrow. Are you ready?
sents.spokenZh: 小明，你们明天开学，你准备好了吗？

sents.zh: 明天就开学啊？爸爸，我的书包你看见了吗？
sents.en: School starts tomorrow already? Dad, have you seen my schoolbag?
sents.spokenZh: 明天就开学啊？爸爸，我的书包你看见了吗？

sents.zh: 书包在门后面。
sents.en: The schoolbag is behind the door.
sents.spokenZh: 书包在门后面。

sents.zh: 书在哪儿呢？笔呢？
sents.en: Where are the books? And the pens?
sents.spokenZh: 书在哪儿呢？笔呢？

sents.zh: 书在床上，笔在桌子上。
sents.en: The books are on the bed, and the pens are on the table.
sents.spokenZh: 书在床上，笔在桌子上。

sents.zh: 太好了！现在都准备好了。
sents.en: Great! Everything is ready now.
sents.spokenZh: 太好了！现在都准备好了。

sents.zh: 这次爸爸帮你，下次你自己准备，好不好？
sents.en: Dad helped you this time. Next time you prepare by yourself, okay?
sents.spokenZh: 这次爸爸帮你，下次你自己准备，好不好？

sents.zh: 好！
sents.en: Okay!
sents.spokenZh: 好！

sents.zh: 小雪，你在做什么呢？
sents.en: Xiaoxue, what are you doing?
sents.spokenZh: 小雪，你在做什么呢？

sents.zh: 明天考试，我在看书呢。
sents.en: I have an exam tomorrow, so I'm reading.
sents.spokenZh: 明天考试，我在看书呢。

sents.zh: 这些词要好好看看。
sents.en: You should review these words carefully.
sents.spokenZh: 这些词要好好看看。

sents.zh: 我看过了，意思也都懂了。
sents.en: I've reviewed them, and I understand all their meanings.
sents.spokenZh: 我看过了，意思也都懂了。

sents.zh: 你的本子呢？本子上做错的题也要看一看。
sents.en: Where's your notebook? You should also go over the questions you got wrong in it.
sents.spokenZh: 你的本子呢？本子上做错的题也要看一看。

sents.zh: 妈妈，是您准备考试还是我准备考试？
sents.en: Mom, are you the one preparing for the exam or am I?
sents.spokenZh: 妈妈，是您准备考试还是我准备考试？

sents.zh: 妈妈，我回来了！
sents.en: Mom, I'm back!
sents.spokenZh: 妈妈，我回来了！

sents.zh: 我买了奶茶，就在桌子上，自己去拿吧。
sents.en: I bought bubble tea; it's on the table. Go get it yourself.
sents.spokenZh: 我买了奶茶，就在桌子上，自己去拿吧。

sents.zh: 谢谢妈妈！
sents.en: Thank you, Mom!
sents.spokenZh: 谢谢妈妈！

sents.zh: 今天考试考得怎么样？
sents.en: How did your exam go today?
sents.spokenZh: 今天考试考得怎么样？

sents.zh: 我觉得比上次好。
sents.en: I think I did better than last time.
sents.spokenZh: 我觉得比上次好。

sents.zh: 真不错！饭菜快要做好了，你叫弟弟一起去洗手吧。
sents.en: Really good! The food is almost ready. Go ask your little brother to wash hands with you.
sents.spokenZh: 真不错！饭菜快要做好了，你叫弟弟一起去洗手吧。

sents.zh: 妈妈，我是第一名，姐姐还没洗完呢。
sents.en: Mom, I finished first — my sister hasn't finished washing yet.
sents.spokenZh: 妈妈，我是第一名，姐姐还没洗完呢。

sents.zh: 你洗得真快啊！
sents.en: You washed so quickly!
sents.spokenZh: 你洗得真快啊！

sents.zh: 快要开学了，爸爸帮弟弟准备书包、本子和笔。
sents.en: School is about to start, and Dad is helping my younger brother prepare his schoolbag, notebooks, and pens.
sents.spokenZh: 快要开学了，爸爸帮弟弟准备书包、本子和笔。

sents.zh: 我就要考试了，妈妈让我看书、看做错的题。
sents.en: I'm about to take an exam, and Mom asked me to read my books and review the questions I got wrong.
sents.spokenZh: 我就要考试了，妈妈让我看书、看做错的题。

sents.zh: 我们上学，爸爸、妈妈比我们还忙。
sents.en: When we go to school, Mom and Dad are even busier than we are.
sents.spokenZh: 我们上学，爸爸、妈妈比我们还忙。

sents.zh: 我问他们：“是我和弟弟上学还是你们上学？”
sents.en: I asked them, "Is it my brother and me going to school, or is it you?"
sents.spokenZh: 我问他们：“是我和弟弟上学还是你们上学？”

sents.zh: 我问完，他们都笑了。
sents.en: After I asked, they both laughed.
sents.spokenZh: 我问完，他们都笑了。

sents.zh: 家月，都下课了，你怎么还不回家？
sents.en: Jiayue, class is over. Why haven't you gone home yet?
sents.spokenZh: 家月，都下课了，你怎么还不回家？

sents.zh: 我头疼，不太舒服。
sents.en: I have a headache; I'm not feeling well.
sents.spokenZh: 我头疼，不太舒服。

sents.zh: 你这几天经常头疼，去医院看看吧。
sents.en: You've been having headaches frequently these days. You should go to the hospital.
sents.spokenZh: 你这几天经常头疼，去医院看看吧。

sents.zh: 我想休息一下，现在不能动，一动就疼。
sents.en: I want to rest for a while. I can't move right now — it hurts whenever I move.
sents.spokenZh: 我想休息一下，现在不能动，一动就疼。

sents.zh: 那你在这儿坐着，我去开车，一会儿送你去医院。
sents.en: Then sit here. I'll go get the car and take you to the hospital in a bit.
sents.spokenZh: 那你在这儿坐着，我去开车，一会儿送你去医院。

sents.zh: 谢谢王老师。
sents.en: Thank you, Ms. Wang.
sents.spokenZh: 谢谢王老师。

sents.zh: 现在路上车多，还下着雪，我开慢一点儿。
sents.en: There are a lot of cars on the road now, and it's snowing. I'll drive a bit slower.
sents.spokenZh: 现在路上车多，还下着雪，我开慢一点儿。

sents.zh: 没问题，现在头没那么疼了。
sents.en: No problem. My head doesn't hurt as much now.
sents.spokenZh: 没问题，现在头没那么疼了。

sents.zh: 好。李文来电话了，你帮我接一下。
sents.en: Okay. Li Wen is calling — please answer it for me.
sents.spokenZh: 好。李文来电话了，你帮我接一下。

sents.zh: 喂，李文，王老师开着车呢，你找她有事吗？
sents.en: Hello, Li Wen. Ms. Wang is driving. Do you need her for something?
sents.spokenZh: 喂，李文，王老师开着车呢，你找她有事吗？

sents.zh: 没什么事。今天雪这么大，你们开车去哪儿啊？
sents.en: Nothing important. The snow is so heavy today — where are you driving to?
sents.spokenZh: 没什么事。今天雪这么大，你们开车去哪儿啊？

sents.zh: 去医院，我头有点儿疼。
sents.en: To the hospital. I have a bit of a headache.
sents.spokenZh: 去医院，我头有点儿疼。

sents.zh: 那我一会儿去看看你。
sents.en: Then I'll come visit you in a while.
sents.spokenZh: 那我一会儿去看看你。

sents.zh: 李文，快请进！
sents.en: Li Wen, please come in!
sents.spokenZh: 李文，快请进！

sents.zh: 家月，你怎么样了？头还疼吗？
sents.en: Jiayue, how are you feeling? Does your head still hurt?
sents.spokenZh: 家月，你怎么样了？头还疼吗？

sents.zh: 不那么疼了。医生开了一些药，吃完就好多了。
sents.en: It doesn't hurt as much. The doctor prescribed some medicine, and I felt much better after taking it.
sents.spokenZh: 不那么疼了。医生开了一些药，吃完就好多了。

sents.zh: 那就好！
sents.en: That's good to hear!
sents.spokenZh: 那就好！

sents.zh: 家月，你想不想吃点儿东西？
sents.en: Jiayue, do you want something to eat?
sents.spokenZh: 家月，你想不想吃点儿东西？

sents.zh: 吃点儿吧，身体不舒服时更要好好吃饭。
sents.en: Eat something. You should eat well especially when you're not feeling well.
sents.spokenZh: 吃点儿吧，身体不舒服时更要好好吃饭。

sents.zh: 吃点儿什么呢？
sents.en: What should I eat?
sents.spokenZh: 吃点儿什么呢？

sents.zh: 你最喜欢吃中国菜，我做几个中国菜吧。
sents.en: You like Chinese food the most, so I'll cook a few Chinese dishes.
sents.spokenZh: 你最喜欢吃中国菜，我做几个中国菜吧。

sents.zh: 好的，谢谢王老师。
sents.en: Okay, thank you, Ms. Wang.
sents.spokenZh: 好的，谢谢王老师。

sents.zh: 我这几天经常头疼，从药店买了点儿药，没去医院。
sents.en: I've been having frequent headaches these days; I bought some medicine at the pharmacy and didn't go to the hospital.
sents.spokenZh: 我这几天经常头疼，从药店买了点儿药，没去医院。

sents.zh: 今天下课后，王老师看我不舒服，就送我去医院了。
sents.en: After class today, Ms. Wang saw that I wasn't feeling well and took me to the hospital.
sents.spokenZh: 今天下课后，王老师看我不舒服，就送我去医院了。

sents.zh: 从医院回来，李文也来看我了。
sents.en: After I got back from the hospital, Li Wen also came to see me.
sents.spokenZh: 从医院回来，李文也来看我了。

sents.zh: 现在他们都回去了，我也要睡觉了。
sents.en: Now they've all gone home, and I'm going to bed too.
sents.spokenZh: 现在他们都回去了，我也要睡觉了。

sents.zh: 喂，家月，是你啊！有什么事情吗？
sents.en: Hello, Jiayue, it's you! Is there anything you need?
sents.spokenZh: 喂，家月，是你啊！有什么事情吗？

sents.zh: 没什么事，就想跟您说说话。
sents.en: Nothing in particular — I just wanted to talk to you.
sents.spokenZh: 没什么事，就想跟您说说话。

sents.zh: 好啊。你今天没课吗？
sents.en: Sure. Don't you have class today?
sents.spokenZh: 好啊。你今天没课吗？

sents.zh: 下午有课。您那里天气怎么样？
sents.en: I have class in the afternoon. How's the weather over there?
sents.spokenZh: 下午有课。您那里天气怎么样？

sents.zh: 北京这几天虽然是晴天，但是有点儿冷。
sents.en: Although it's been sunny in Beijing these days, it's a bit cold.
sents.spokenZh: 北京这几天虽然是晴天，但是有点儿冷。

sents.zh: 我这里比北京冷多了，外边还正下着雪呢！
sents.en: It's much colder here than in Beijing — it's snowing outside right now!
sents.spokenZh: 我这里比北京冷多了，外边还正下着雪呢！

sents.zh: 喂，一飞，听家月说你那边下雪了，下得大不大？
sents.en: Hello, Yifei. Jiayue told me it's snowing over there. Is it heavy?
sents.spokenZh: 喂，一飞，听家月说你那边下雪了，下得大不大？

sents.zh: 今天不大，昨天比今天下得大。
sents.en: Not heavy today — yesterday it snowed harder than today.
sents.spokenZh: 今天不大，昨天比今天下得大。

sents.zh: 天气不好，你去外面的时候多穿点儿衣服。
sents.en: The weather isn't good. Wear more clothes when you go outside.
sents.spokenZh: 天气不好，你去外面的时候多穿点儿衣服。

sents.zh: 这几天我在网上上课，没出去过。
sents.en: I've been teaching classes online these days, so I haven't gone out.
sents.spokenZh: 这几天我在网上上课，没出去过。

sents.zh: 那就好，有事记得给我打电话。
sents.en: That's good. Remember to call me if anything comes up.
sents.spokenZh: 那就好，有事记得给我打电话。

sents.zh: 好的。现在不下雪了，我出去买点儿吃的。
sents.en: Okay. It's stopped snowing now, so I'll go out and buy some food.
sents.spokenZh: 好的。现在不下雪了，我出去买点儿吃的。

sents.zh: 一次多买点儿，阴天下雪什么的就少出去吧。
sents.en: Buy more at once, and go out less when it's cloudy or snowy.
sents.spokenZh: 一次多买点儿，阴天下雪什么的就少出去吧。

sents.zh: 喂，家月，今天天气不错，我们去跑步吧！
sents.en: Hello, Jiayue! The weather is nice today — let's go for a run!
sents.spokenZh: 喂，家月，今天天气不错，我们去跑步吧！

sents.zh: 你跑步跑得比我快，我们能一起跑吗？
sents.en: You run faster than me. Can we really run together?
sents.spokenZh: 你跑步跑得比我快，我们能一起跑吗？

sents.zh: 可以的，我慢慢跑，等着你。
sents.en: Of course. I'll run slowly and wait for you.
sents.spokenZh: 可以的，我慢慢跑，等着你。

sents.zh: 好吧。你真爱跑步啊！
sents.en: Alright. You really love running!
sents.spokenZh: 好吧。你真爱跑步啊！

sents.zh: 我从小就经常跟爸爸跑步，跑步能让人快乐！
sents.en: I've often run with my dad since childhood. Running makes people happy!
sents.spokenZh: 我从小就经常跟爸爸跑步，跑步能让人快乐！

sents.zh: 好，那我准备一下。
sents.en: Okay, then I'll get ready.
sents.spokenZh: 好，那我准备一下。

sents.zh: 我现在坐地铁去找你，一会儿楼下见。
sents.en: I'm taking the subway to your place now. See you downstairs in a bit.
sents.spokenZh: 我现在坐地铁去找你，一会儿楼下见。

sents.zh: 前几天天气不好，我没走路，每天坐两站地铁去学校。
sents.en: The weather was bad over the past few days, so I didn't walk — I took the subway two stops to school every day.
sents.spokenZh: 前几天天气不好，我没走路，每天坐两站地铁去学校。

sents.zh: 今天是个大晴天，李文让我跟他去外面跑步。
sents.en: Today was a beautiful sunny day, and Li Wen asked me to go running outside with him.
sents.spokenZh: 今天是个大晴天，李文让我跟他去外面跑步。

sents.zh: 他小时候经常跑步，跑得比我快，但是他会等我。
sents.en: He ran often as a child and runs faster than me, but he waits for me.
sents.spokenZh: 他小时候经常跑步，跑得比我快，但是他会等我。

sents.zh: 跟李文一起跑步，我好高兴啊！
sents.en: Running with Li Wen made me so happy!
sents.spokenZh: 跟李文一起跑步，我好高兴啊！

sents.zh: 时间过得真快啊！新年就要到了。
sents.en: Time flies! The New Year is almost here.
sents.spokenZh: 时间过得真快啊！新年就要到了。

sents.zh: 这一年王老师教我们中文，每天工作都很累。
sents.en: This year Ms. Wang has been teaching us Chinese, and she works so hard every day.
sents.spokenZh: 这一年王老师教我们中文，每天工作都很累。

sents.zh: 是啊，她教得很好。因为她，我们都非常爱上中文课。
sents.en: Yes, she teaches very well. Because of her, we all love attending Chinese class.
sents.spokenZh: 是啊，她教得很好。因为她，我们都非常爱上中文课。

sents.zh: 我们给她准备个新年礼物吧。你觉得送给她什么好呢？
sents.en: Let's prepare a New Year's gift for her. What do you think we can present to her?
sents.spokenZh: 我们给她准备个新年礼物吧。你觉得送给她什么好呢？

sents.zh: 王老师喜欢花，就送给她花吧。
sents.en: Ms. Wang likes flowers. I think we can give her flowers.
sents.spokenZh: 王老师喜欢花，就送给她花吧。

sents.zh: 那我们去花店看看，现在买花的人多，希望花店还有漂亮的花。
sents.en: Then let's go to the flower shop; there are many people buying flowers now. I hope there are still some beautiful flowers in the shop.
sents.spokenZh: 那我们去花店看看，现在买花的人多，希望花店还有漂亮的花。

sents.zh: 王老师，今天的词比昨天多了十个。
sents.en: Ms. Wang, today's vocabulary has ten more words than yesterday's.
sents.spokenZh: 王老师，今天的词比昨天多了十个。

sents.zh: 是啊！你们都学会了吗？
sents.en: Yes! Have you all learned them?
sents.spokenZh: 是啊！你们都学会了吗？

sents.zh: 学会了，没有问题。
sents.en: We've learned them. No problem.
sents.spokenZh: 学会了，没有问题。

sents.zh: 好。现在我来说，你们在本子上面写。
sents.en: Good. Now I'll say them, and you write them down in your notebooks.
sents.spokenZh: 好。现在我来说，你们在本子上面写。

sents.zh: 同学们，“洗手间”的“间”字写错了，它的里面是“日”，不是“口”。
sents.en: Class, the character 间 in 洗手间 is wrong. The part inside is 日, not 口.
sents.spokenZh: 同学们，“洗手间”的“间”字写错了，它的里面是“日”，不是“口”。

sents.zh: “日”比“口”多一笔，写“口”就是“问题”的“问”了。
sents.en: 日 has one more stroke than 口. Writing 口 turns it into the 问 in 问题.
sents.spokenZh: “日”比“口”多一笔，写“口”就是“问题”的“问”了。

sents.zh: 没错，你说得很对。
sents.en: Yes, you are right.
sents.spokenZh: 没错，你说得很对。

sents.zh: 家月，你觉得这个本子怎么样？
sents.en: Jiayue, what do you think of this notebook?
sents.spokenZh: 家月，你觉得这个本子怎么样？

sents.zh: 很漂亮，多少钱一个？
sents.en: It's very pretty. How much is it?
sents.spokenZh: 很漂亮，多少钱一个？

sents.zh: 比我们一起买的那个本子贵一点儿。
sents.en: It's a bit more expensive than the notebook we bought together.
sents.spokenZh: 比我们一起买的那个本子贵一点儿。

sents.zh: 这么漂亮的本子，不可能贵一点儿吧？
sents.en: For such a beautiful notebook, it couldn't be just a little more expensive, right?
sents.spokenZh: 这么漂亮的本子，不可能贵一点儿吧？

sents.zh: 我是上网买的，真没那么贵。我买了两个，送你一个。
sents.en: I bought it online, and it's really not that expensive. I bought two and will give you one.
sents.spokenZh: 我是上网买的，真没那么贵。我买了两个，送你一个。

sents.zh: 谢谢！那我送给你什么呢？
sents.en: Thank you! Then what should I give you in return?
sents.spokenZh: 谢谢！那我送给你什么呢？

sents.zh: 咖啡杯吧，我最喜欢喝咖啡了。
sents.en: A coffee cup would be great. I like drinking coffee the most.
sents.spokenZh: 咖啡杯吧，我最喜欢喝咖啡了。

sents.zh: 好，那样我们就都有新年礼物了！
sents.en: Alright! Then we'll both have New Year's gifts!
sents.spokenZh: 好，那样我们就都有新年礼物了！

sents.zh: 新年就要到了，安妮送给我一个新本子。
sents.en: The New Year is almost here. Annie gave me a new notebook.
sents.spokenZh: 新年就要到了，安妮送给我一个新本子。

sents.zh: 她告诉我是在网上买的，比我的本子贵一点儿。
sents.en: She told me she bought it online, and it's a bit more expensive than mine.
sents.spokenZh: 她告诉我是在网上买的，比我的本子贵一点儿。

sents.zh: 我们班同学也送了王老师漂亮的花，希望她高高兴兴地过个新年。
sents.en: Our classmates also gave Ms. Wang beautiful flowers, hoping she will have a happy New Year.
sents.spokenZh: 我们班同学也送了王老师漂亮的花，希望她高高兴兴地过个新年。

sents.zh: 王老师，你家楼下站着一个人。
sents.en: Ms. Wang, there's someone standing downstairs at your building.
sents.spokenZh: 王老师，你家楼下站着一个人。

sents.zh: 我家楼下？我看看。
sents.en: Downstairs at my building? Let me take a look.
sents.spokenZh: 我家楼下？我看看。

sents.zh: 那个人穿着黑色的裤子，手里还拿着一个黑色的包。
sents.en: That person is wearing black pants and holding a black bag.
sents.spokenZh: 那个人穿着黑色的裤子，手里还拿着一个黑色的包。

sents.zh: 我看见那个人了，他是我男朋友。
sents.en: I see him. He is my boyfriend.
sents.spokenZh: 我看见那个人了，他是我男朋友。

sents.zh: 那我们快过去吧。
sents.en: Let's go over quickly then.
sents.spokenZh: 那我们快过去吧。

sents.zh: 同乐，真是你啊！上次打电话，你说有时间过来看我，没想到这么快就来了！
sents.en: Tongle, it really is you! Last time we talked on the phone, you said you'd visit me when you had time. I didn't expect you to come so soon!
sents.spokenZh: 同乐，真是你啊！上次打电话，你说有时间过来看我，没想到这么快就来了！

sents.zh: 就要过年了，你一个人在这儿多没意思啊，所以我就早早过来了。
sents.en: The Spring Festival is almost here. It's no fun for you to be here all alone, so I came here as soon as possible.
sents.spokenZh: 就要过年了，你一个人在这儿多没意思啊，所以我就早早过来了。

sents.zh: 你能来，我太高兴了！
sents.en: I'm so happy you could come!
sents.spokenZh: 你能来，我太高兴了！

sents.zh: 一飞，你旁边这位是？
sents.en: Yifei, who's this next to you?
sents.spokenZh: 一飞，你旁边这位是？

sents.zh: 同乐，这是李文，他在我们学校学医。李文，这是我男朋友杨同乐。
sents.en: Tongle, this is Li Wen. He's studying medicine at our school. Li Wen, this is my boyfriend, Yang Tongle.
sents.spokenZh: 同乐，这是李文，他在我们学校学医。李文，这是我男朋友杨同乐。

sents.zh: 李文，很高兴认识你！
sents.en: Li Wen, nice to meet you!
sents.spokenZh: 李文，很高兴认识你！

sents.zh: 认识你我也很高兴！我家就在前面那个楼，有时间来玩。
sents.en: Nice to meet you too! My home is just in that building up ahead. Feel free to come over when you have time.
sents.spokenZh: 认识你我也很高兴！我家就在前面那个楼，有时间来玩。

sents.zh: 一飞，你住的房子真不错，很大，离学校也不远。
sents.en: Yifei, your house is really nice, very big, and not far from school.
sents.spokenZh: 一飞，你住的房子真不错，很大，离学校也不远。

sents.zh: 是啊！我楼下还住着一家中国人，他们人很好。
sents.en: Yes! There's a Chinese family living downstairs, and they are very nice.
sents.spokenZh: 是啊！我楼下还住着一家中国人，他们人很好。

sents.zh: 这样你有事情就可以找他们帮忙。
sents.en: Then you can ask them for help if you ever need anything.
sents.spokenZh: 这样你有事情就可以找他们帮忙。

sents.zh: 对，我也帮他们家的小孩儿学中文。
sents.en: Yes, I also help their child learn Chinese.
sents.spokenZh: 对，我也帮他们家的小孩儿学中文。

sents.zh: 我记得你跟我说过，是个女孩儿，学得也很好。
sents.en: I remember you told me that child was a girl, and she learned so well.
sents.spokenZh: 我记得你跟我说过，是个女孩儿，学得也很好。

sents.zh: 没错，她经常跑上来找我玩。
sents.en: Exactly, she often comes upstairs to play with me.
sents.spokenZh: 没错，她经常跑上来找我玩。

sents.zh: 你问问他们什么时候有时间，我请他们吃个饭。
sents.en: You can ask them when they're free, and I'll treat them to a meal.
sents.spokenZh: 你问问他们什么时候有时间，我请他们吃个饭。

sents.zh: 我男朋友姓杨，叫杨同乐。
sents.en: My boyfriend's last name is Yang, and his full name is Yang Tongle.
sents.spokenZh: 我男朋友姓杨，叫杨同乐。

sents.zh: 他高个子、大眼睛，唱歌唱得很好，跳舞跳得也不错。
sents.en: He is tall, has big eyes, sings very well, and is also good at dancing.
sents.spokenZh: 他高个子、大眼睛，唱歌唱得很好，跳舞跳得也不错。

sents.zh: 他和我姐姐一起工作，是姐姐介绍我们认识的。
sents.en: He works with my older sister, and it was she who introduced us.
sents.spokenZh: 他和我姐姐一起工作，是姐姐介绍我们认识的。

sents.zh: 他告诉我，从见到我的第一天开始，他就喜欢上我了。
sents.en: He told me that he liked me from the very first day he met me.
sents.spokenZh: 他告诉我，从见到我的第一天开始，他就喜欢上我了。

sents.zh: 考试就要开始了，请大家写上姓名，写好后就可以做题了。
sents.en: The exam is about to begin. Please write down your name, and once you're done, you can start answering the questions.
sents.spokenZh: 考试就要开始了，请大家写上姓名，写好后就可以做题了。

sents.zh: 老师，我做完了。
sents.en: Teacher, I'm finished.
sents.spokenZh: 老师，我做完了。

sents.zh: 老师，我也做完了。
sents.en: Teacher, I'm finished too.
sents.spokenZh: 老师，我也做完了。

sents.zh: ……对了，你们考完试想做什么？
sents.en: ... Oh, what are you going to do after the exam?
sents.spokenZh: ……对了，你们考完试想做什么？

sents.zh: 我很想去中国，虽然去过一次，但是很想再去一次。
sents.en: I want to go to China. I've been there once, but I really want to go again.
sents.spokenZh: 我很想去中国，虽然去过一次，但是很想再去一次。

sents.zh: 不错，到中国后你就可以经常说中文了。
sents.en: Good, you can often speak Chinese in China.
sents.spokenZh: 不错，到中国后你就可以经常说中文了。

sents.zh: 考完试了，我现在可以出国旅游了。
sents.en: The exam is over, so now I can travel abroad.
sents.spokenZh: 考完试了，我现在可以出国旅游了。

sents.zh: 你要去哪儿？
sents.en: Where are you planning to go?
sents.spokenZh: 你要去哪儿？

sents.zh: 我要再去一次北京。
sents.en: I want to go to Beijing again.
sents.spokenZh: 我要再去一次北京。

sents.zh: 为什么还去北京？
sents.en: Why Beijing again?
sents.spokenZh: 为什么还去北京？

sents.zh: 因为我想再吃一次烤鸭，再喝一次奶茶，再去北京大学看一次电影……
sents.en: Because I want to eat Peking Duck again, drink bubble tea again, and watch a movie at Peking University again...
sents.spokenZh: 因为我想再吃一次烤鸭，再喝一次奶茶，再去北京大学看一次电影……

sents.zh: 你想做的事情很多啊！
sents.en: You want to do a lot of things!
sents.spokenZh: 你想做的事情很多啊！

sents.zh: 是啊，你看，我还在网上买好颐和园的门票了呢。
sents.en: Yes, look, I've already bought a ticket for the Summer Palace online.
sents.spokenZh: 是啊，你看，我还在网上买好颐和园的门票了呢。

sents.zh: 我的高中同学就在颐和园上班，可以让他给你好好介绍介绍。
sents.en: One of my high school classmates works at the Summer Palace, and he can give you a great tour.
sents.spokenZh: 我的高中同学就在颐和园上班，可以让他给你好好介绍介绍。

sents.zh: 太好了！出门旅游，多个朋友多条路。
sents.en: That's amazing! When you travel, the more friends you have, the more paths you have.
sents.spokenZh: 太好了！出门旅游，多个朋友多条路。

sents.zh: 李文，你有一年没回国了吧？
sents.en: Li Wen, you haven't been back to China for a year, right?
sents.spokenZh: 李文，你有一年没回国了吧？

sents.zh: 不到一年。我六月的时候回去了一次。
sents.en: Not quite a year. I went back once this June.
sents.spokenZh: 不到一年。我六月的时候回去了一次。

sents.zh: 我怎么忘了？还是我送你去的机场呢。
sents.en: How could I forget? I was the one who took you to the airport.
sents.spokenZh: 我怎么忘了？还是我送你去的机场呢。

sents.zh: 是啊。
sents.en: Yes.
sents.spokenZh: 是啊。

sents.zh: 我记得你那次的机票很便宜。
sents.en: I remember your air ticket was very cheap.
sents.spokenZh: 我记得你那次的机票很便宜。

sents.zh: 没错，可能因为那个时候去北京的人不多吧。
sents.en: Exactly. Maybe it was because there weren't many people going to Beijing at that time.
sents.spokenZh: 没错，可能因为那个时候去北京的人不多吧。

sents.zh: 这次的机票虽然有点儿贵，但想到就要飞北京了，我还是很高兴的。
sents.en: The air ticket is a little expensive this time, but I am so happy thinking about going to Beijing.
sents.spokenZh: 这次的机票虽然有点儿贵，但想到就要飞北京了，我还是很高兴的。

sents.zh: 我六月的时候回过一次北京，现在有半年多没回去了，我有点儿想家。
sents.en: I went back to Beijing once this June, and now it has been over six months since I last went back. I miss home a bit.
sents.spokenZh: 我六月的时候回过一次北京，现在有半年多没回去了，我有点儿想家。

sents.zh: 就要过年了，我要回家过年。
sents.en: The Spring Festival is coming, and I'll be going back to celebrate it.
sents.spokenZh: 就要过年了，我要回家过年。

sents.zh: 家月这次也要去北京，我们都是星期五的飞机。
sents.en: Jiayue is also going to Beijing—we're both on the same flight this Friday.
sents.spokenZh: 家月这次也要去北京，我们都是星期五的飞机。

sents.zh: 家月说我们好像小鸟，一起飞到北京，再一起飞回这里。
sents.en: Jiayue said we are like little birds, flying to Beijing together and then flying back here together.
sents.spokenZh: 家月说我们好像小鸟，一起飞到北京，再一起飞回这里。
